description: You are setting up a new wine store catalog. Create three new dropdown product attributes: 'wine_region' (Values: Napa Valley, Bordeaux, Tuscany, Rioja, Barossa Valley), 'wine_varietal' (Values: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc), and 'wine_vintage' (Values: 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022). All three must be set to 'Filterable (with results)' for Layered Navigation, and used in Product Listings and Search. Finally, add these attributes to the 'Default' attribute set under a new group named 'Wine Details'.
